claim: AlphaFold2 focuses on apo structures and overlooks ligands and associated holo structures.
source_text: Despite AlphaFold2's strides in protein native structure prediction, its focus on apo structures overlooks ligands and associated holo structures.
evidence_reasoning: This claim is based on established understanding of AlphaFold2's training and design objectives, which focus on predicting protein structures without ligands.

claim: AF2RAVE-Glide enables computational model-based small-molecule binding of metastable protein kinase conformations initiated from protein sequences.
source_text: Here, we demonstrate an AlphaFold2-based framework combined with all-atom enhanced sampling molecular dynamics and Induced Fit docking, named AF2RAVE-Glide, to conduct computational model-based small-molecule binding of metastable protein kinase conformations, initiated from protein sequences.
evidence_reasoning: The claim is supported by the experimental workflow and results presented in the manuscript demonstrating the framework's capabilities.

claim: AF2RAVE enables sampling of metastable DFG-out conformations for different kinases with sufficient accuracy to enable docking of known type II kinase inhibitors with more than 50% success rates.
source_text: Here, we demonstrate how with AF2RAVE these metastable conformations can be sampled for different kinases with high enough accuracy to enable subsequent docking of known type II kinase inhibitors with more than 50% success rates across docking calculations.
evidence_reasoning: This claim is directly supported by the docking success rate data presented in the manuscript's results.

claim: Ligands targeting highly diverse metastable conformations should result in better selectivity due to similarity of native structures among protein homologs.
source_text: Moreover, due to the similarity of native structures among protein homologs, it has been widely believed that ligands targeting highly diverse metastable conformations should result in better selectivity (Davis et al., 2011).
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by a citation to Davis et al., 2011, indicating it draws from prior published work.

claim: The AF2RAVE protocol integrates rMSA AF2 and RAVE method to systematically explore metastable states and accurately rank structures using Boltzmann weights.
source_text: The AF2RAVE protocol integrates rMSA AF2 and the machine learning-based reweighted autoencoded variational Bayes for enhanced sampling (RAVE) method (Wang et al., 2019; Wang and Tiwary, 2021; Mehdi et al., 2024) to systematically explore metastable states and accurately rank structures using Boltzmann weights (Vani et al., 2023).
evidence_reasoning: The claim describes the protocol's methodology and is supported by citations to the underlying methods.

claim: The human genome contains about 500 protein kinases which share highly conserved structures in their catalytic ATP-binding pocket.
source_text: The human genome contains about 500 protein kinases which share highly conserved structures in their catalytic ATP-binding pocket, due to the selection pressure toward functional catalysis.
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about the human kinome and its structural conservation.

claim: Type I inhibitors bind to the ATP-binding site adopting the active catalytic state, while type II inhibitors target binding pockets adjacent to the ATP-binding site adopting the inactive state.
source_text: type I inhibitors bind to the ATP-binding site adopting the active catalytic state, while type II inhibitors target the binding pockets adjacent to the ATP-binding site adopting the inactive state.
evidence_reasoning: This describes established classifications of kinase inhibitors based on their binding modes.

claim: In the active state, the A-loop is extended to create a cleft for substrate peptides to bind, while in the inactive state, it is collapsed or folded onto the protein surface, blocking substrate binding.

claim: In the active state, the DFG motif adopts a DFG-in conformation with the Asp side-chain pointing inward to the ATP-binding pocket, while in the inactive state, the Asp side-chain is flipped outward in the DFG-out conformation.
source_text: Additionally, in the active state, the three residues 'Asp-Phe-Gly' (DFG motif) at the N-terminus of the A-loop bind to an ATP-binding Mg2+ ion, with the Asp side-chain pointing inward to the ATP-binding pocket, while in the inactive state, the Asp side-chain is flipped outward, and the DFG motif adopts the DFG-out conformation
evidence_reasoning: This describes established structural features of kinase conformational states, supported by citation to Modi and Dunbrack, 2019.

claim: AF2 structures of Abl1/DDR1 kinases exhibit superior performance when docking with type I inhibitors (achieving a minimum ligand RMSD of 2.14 Å) compared to docking with type II inhibitors.

claim: AF2 structures struggle to dock with type II inhibitors using Glide IFD and DiffDock, with ligand RMSDs above 8 Å across all docking poses.

evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by experimental docking data showing poor performance across multiple methods.
